```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    if not isinstance(nodes, list):
        raise ValueError("nodes must be a list")
    if not isinstance(case["required_symbols"], list):
        raise ValueError("required_symbols must be a list")
    
    # Build node map and children map
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        node_id = node["id"]
        node_map[node_id] = node
        children[node_id] = []
    
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node.get("parent")
        if parent is not None:
            if parent not in children:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {parent} not found")
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    
    # Sort nodes: deeper first, then by node ID for ties
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removed_ids = []
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        node_id = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        has_retained_children = any(child in retained for child in children[node_id])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols still present
        tentative_retained = retained - {node_id}
        symbols_present = set(node_map[nid]["symbol"] for nid in tentative_retained)
        if not required_symbols.issubset(symbols_present):
            continue
        
        # Remove the node
        retained = tentative_retained
        removed_ids.append(node_id)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_ids,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```
